name: Tess Degenstein
bio: Canadian actress, screenwriter, director, improviser, and voice-over artist who originates from Saskatchewan and has established herself as a versatile performer across multiple entertainment mediums.

credits.title: The Young People
credits.overview: Centers on a couple of school friends, one of whom starts to develop red flag behavior.

credits.title: Guarding Stars
credits.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

credits.title: How Brief
credits.overview: HOW BRIEF is a disappearing act set over the course of one night in 1962 when a restless woman returns to her childhood home for the last time, inspired by the music of singer-songwriter Connie Converse.

credits.title: Keeper
credits.overview: Liz and Malcolm escape for a romantic anniversary weekend at a secluded cabin. When Malcolm suddenly returns to the city, Liz finds herself isolated and in the presence of an unspeakable evil that reveals the cabin's horrifying secrets.

credits.title: The Players
credits.overview: Summer. 1994. Emily is cast as the youngest member of an avant garde theatre production. credits.title: The Monkey
credits.overview: When twin brothers find a mysterious wind-up monkey, a series of outrageous deaths tear their family apart. Twenty-five years later, the monkey begins a new killing spree forcing the estranged brothers to confront the cursed toy.

credits.title: Adult Adoption
credits.overview: Rosy is a 25-year-old bank teller who ‘aged out’ of the foster care system at 18 and has since managed to build a solid yet unspectacular life for herself. credits.overview: A demoralized soldier is lost in the wilderness, one of the few remaining in a militia for hire known as the Mortal Decree. credits.title: First Round Down
credits.overview: When big city problems follow a former hockey star turned hitman to his home town it's clear that he's not the only one with skeletons in his closet in this crime comedy caper involving ex-lovers, old coaches, mobsters and unpaid debts.

credits.title: A Brief History of the Apocalypse
credits.overview: The volatile bond between two young women threatens to combust in the face of an incomprehensible catastrophe.
